title: Surjectivity on spectra is stable under base change
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a ring map whose map $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is surjective. For every ring map $R\to R'$, the base-change map $R'\to R'\otimes_R S$ induces a surjection $\operatorname{Spec}(R'\otimes_R S)\to\operatorname{Spec}R'$ [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change].
